channel.description: Latest articles from The Greymouth Star (greystar.co.nz)

item.title: Rescue chopper changes
item.description: A rebranded and updated West Coast Rescue Helicopter from early 2026 is promised as the biggest transformation for the region’s rescue helicopter service in more than a quarter of a century. The post Rescue chopper changes appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Taramakau Christmas cottage open
item.description: A Taramakau woman is sharing her vast Christmas collection with the West Coast public, all for a good cause. The post Taramakau Christmas cottage open appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Police nab youths
item.description: The troublemaking activities of a group of Greymouth youths came to an abrupt stop early today when the stolen vehicle they were in was road-spiked. The post Police nab youths appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Salvation Army leader to do the legwork for food banks
item.description: Greymouth’s Salvation Army leader, Major Gavin Baxter is lacing up his boots for one final act of service as an officer as he eases into retirement this week. The post Salvation Army leader to do the legwork for food banks appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Coast home hit by twister
item.description: Grey Valley couple Juanita and Richard Exter woke to a surprise this morning to find the roof of their porch no longer attached to the house after a freak weather incident overnight. The post Coast home hit by twister appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: All aboard the Hogwarts express
item.description: Excited young wizards and witches filled Shantytown today for a Harry Potter-inspired Wizarding Wonders school holiday programme. The post All aboard the Hogwarts express appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Regent bounces back
item.description: The dark clouds hanging over the Regent Theatre have finally parted and the Greymouth venue is now facing a more positive outlook than last year. The post Regent bounces back appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Kittens fill Coast SPCA centres
item.description: The SPCA is seeking foster homes on the West Coast, with kitten season in full swing. The post Kittens fill Coast SPCA centres appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: Big-fish contest on the line
item.description: Westport will host a new month-long big game fishing competition next month with the launch of the Buller Bluewater Classic, following an exceptional 2025 season that saw rare bluewater species landed in that port and Greymouth. PICTURE: Supplied The post Big-fish contest on the line appeared first on Greymouth Star.

item.title: SH7 closure lacks “common sense”
item.description: The vital link between Greymouth and Reefton, temporarily severed without a local detour, lacks “common sense” according to locals affected by the three-day closure of State Highway 7. PICTURE: Lois Williams The post SH7 closure lacks “common sense” appeared first on Greymouth Star.
